method.reader: single AI analyst; no independent recovery or human curve review
method.viewed: complete page rendering, including both plots and legends
method.scope: all seven bolt counts in both panels, both model styles
method.coordinate_convention: Approximate horizontal axis locations in metres are navigation cues read from printed ticks, not measured interval endpoints. No vertical ordinates extracted.
method.selection: Full-panel reading in force/energy order and bolt-count order. No discrepancy calculated or selected for human acceptance.
method.support_rule: Descriptions of a visible dashed route include gaps only as navigation; no dash-gap bridging or support admission. Same-color crossings and near-overlaps remain unresolved.
method.uncertainty: Source-native linewidth, JPEG color spread, exact stroke footprints and continuous identity have not been measured. Qualitative mapping must not be read as calibrated error bounds.
